profile.description: Large annual Boise balloon festival. The 2026 event includes Kids Day, Family Morning Launch and a paid Inflatable Fun Zone at Nite Glow.

contacts.name: Mike Owens
contacts.role: Townsquare Media Boise Market President / event contact

notes.subject: 2026 competitor selected for profit-share inflatable zone
notes.body: Mike Owens replied Aug. 4, 2026 that the Spirit of Boise Balloon Classic was already doing this with another company on a profit-share arrangement. Current official event information confirms the 2026 Balloon Classic runs Sept. 2-6 and includes an Inflatable Fun Zone during Nite Glow. This proves the event is a strong conceptual fit; the 2026 loss is an incumbent-provider issue, not lack of interest in inflatables.

followUps.label: Approach Spirit of Boise early for 2027 Inflatable Fun Zone
followUps.reason: The event already operates a profit-share Inflatable Fun Zone with another provider. Check early whether the 2027 provider agreement is open before it is renewed.
